svg.title: Issue 6 — Page 3 — Panel 3: The briefing breaks up — wide camp shot, the squad disperses
svg.desc: 28mm wide elevated angle. Anomaly map dimming. Luma moves to wall-gap exit (scanner active). Wren turns to her workstation. Jink drops from higher beam. Thresh seated unmoved. Sable apart, watching Luma leave.
svg.text: I could fly escort. Faster than pocket-riding a giant.
No. Luma and Theodore. Two assets, one exposure profile.
Right. Stand down and wait. My specialty.
